attacks.playerSkill: read and reverse a committed port-starboard firing rhythm
attacks.recognitionCue: paired eye and wing-root flares step visibly from port to starboard before each committed needle lane
attacks.telegraph: the firing-side wings brace and its authored needle mount becomes visible before the damaging needle leaves the moving muzzle
attacks.boundedVariation: fixed port-then-starboard rhythm with phase-scaled five, six, or seven needle lanes per side
attacks.movementRule: cross behind each committed lane, then reverse with the alternating wing bank
attacks.recoil: the firing wing pair kicks backward around its named joints while the opposite bank catches the body
attacks.recovery: needle mounts retract, eyes dim, and all eight wings settle back to the canonical fan

attacks.playerSkill: enter and follow the missing wedge through sequential downward rotating shard salvos
attacks.recognitionCue: the central core opens while the lower wing banks cant toward the next downward salvo rotation
attacks.telegraph: the open core and visible first shard orientation declare the missing wedge before the sequential salvo becomes damaging
attacks.boundedVariation: five salvos in phase one, six in phase two, and eight in phase three; phase three reverses direction after the fourth salvo
attacks.movementRule: enter the declared opening and weave with it as each forward-arc salvo rotates down the arena
attacks.recoil: core aperture snaps back while the lower wings flare away from the emitter
attacks.recovery: core remains open briefly as a visible punish window before returning to `core.closed`

attacks.playerSkill: read a detached eye pair and leave each committed blackout laser lane after it locks
attacks.recognitionCue: the arena becomes pure black while detached red eyes mark one committed laser lane
attacks.telegraph: a thin red line tracks briefly, locks in place, then becomes the stationary damaging beam; the hidden structural body does not supply a second guide
attacks.boundedVariation: two sequential warning-locked beam strikes in each phase, using authored side choices and phase timing
attacks.movementRule: wait for each thin line to lock, then leave that stationary lane before its laser fires
attacks.recoil: the hidden rig recoils through the rooted core while the detached eye pair stays aligned to the committed beam origin
attacks.recovery: the damaging beam clears before Umbra rematerializes through its registered re-entry frames at the exact upper combat anchor

attacks.playerSkill: read each locked corner appearance and vacate the committed physical ram lane
attacks.recognitionCue: the arena blacks out as all eight wings fold into a unique pursuit silhouette and Umbra dissolves through the re-entry frames
attacks.telegraph: registered materialization frames, folded anatomy, dash trail, eye/core light, and corner pose reveal the committed ram without a guide line
attacks.boundedVariation: two authored rams in phase one, four in phase two, and six in phase three, alternating lower and middle corner entries
attacks.movementRule: vacate each warning-locked nonhoming ram lane and let Umbra fully exit the opposite edge before reading the next corner
attacks.recoil: all eight wing mounts overshoot open while the body and core lag behind the stopped dash
attacks.recovery: core stays open and wings droop after the final ram, creating the signature punish window before exact-anchor restoration

phaseTwo.visibleTransformation: the core opens, eye overlays remain active longer, re-entry frames punctuate relocation, and the eight wing mounts adopt a broader hunting fan
phaseTwo.behaviorChange: wing banks coordinate with faster corner relocation and the taught core opening is combined with needle pressure
